summary: Defines an IPv6 Address Specific BGP Extended Community attribute. RFC 4360 had only an IPv4 version, which is a problem for applications that need to tag routes with an IPv6 address. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: BGP routes can carry small tags that mark them with an address. There was a tag for the old kind of address only. This document adds one for the newer, longer kind.

questions: ipv6 address specific bgp extended community
